title: Cyber insurance claims - what policies actually cover
p1: A cyber attack can shut down a business overnight. But here’s the surprising part: having cyber insurance does not always mean every loss gets paid.
p2: Many people think cyber insurance only covers hackers stealing data. In reality, policies may cover things like breach response costs, customer notification expenses, legal support, data recovery, and sometimes business losses caused by downtime.
p3: The catch? Coverage depends on the exact policy wording. Some claims are rejected because businesses missed security requirements, delayed reporting the incident, or assumed a risk was covered when it was excluded. The practical takeaway: don’t just buy cyber insurance — review what events trigger coverage, what costs are included, and what obligations you must follow after an attack.
conclusion: Have you ever checked what your cyber insurance policy actually covers, or did you assume it protects against every cyber risk?
